fields.description:
h1. Prerequisites by component team:

* Clone this issue
* Update component name in title
* Link to parent feature
* Remove `template` label and [template-header]
* Update reporter to yourself
* Component source code available
* Dockerfile follows ODH/Konflux standards - [Scrum teams' guide to the ODH-Release-Builds Konflux Infra|https://docs.google.com/document/d/1w2h69yCHaHRMxP_893G0eCCT9zrCdMPoMjY_tLXc5jU/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.aksex0cuj0kh]
* Lead time requirements are met (2+ weeks)

h2. +DevTestOps will ensure that+

* Build context properly configured
* Konflux build configuration prepared

Ref: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SJtQ8bXL4C72mllipEHHtc_Xs21XHXNLGBt3aJoPqeY/edit?tab=t.0|https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SJtQ8bXL4C72mllipEHHtc_Xs21XHXNLGBt3aJoPqeY/edit?tab=t.0|smart-link]  

*ODH Validation Requirements:*

* Component successfully builds in ODH Konflux (shared responsibility devops + component team)
* All relevant ODH tests pass (Component team)
* Component is validated and incubating in ODH (Component team)
* Component is stable and production-ready in ODH environment

Note: Only after successful completion of all ODH validation requirements can a component be considered for future RHOAI onboarding requests.

||*Upstream Git Repo*||*Image / Quay Repo Name*||*Build Context*||*Dockerfile Link or Path*||*Build triggers*||
| https://github.com/rhoai-rhtap/odh-ai-sixth-demo | quay.io/rhoai/odh-ai-seventh-demo-rhel9 | maas-controller | [Dockerfile.konflux|https://github.com/rhoai-rhtap/odh-ai-sixth-demo/blob/rhoai-3.5-ea.2/maas-controller/Dockerfile.konflux] | |

h1. After the Jira is filled out completely

* *Communicate:* Start a workflow in [+#rhoai-devtestops-requests+|https://redhat.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C07TF3MBMMW] to communicate about the onboarding request.
